data.name: Mayursinh
data.gender_notes: Mayursinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of the Mountain, Sun God
data.long_meaning: Mayursinh is a compound name composed of 'Mayur' (peacock) and 'Sinh' (lion). 'Mayur' represents the sun, beauty, and power. 'Sinh' represents courage, strength, and the king of the jungle. Thus, Mayursinh is the lord of the mountain and the Sun God. The name Mayursinh carries the meaning “Lord of the Mountain, Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Mayursinh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the mountain, sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mayursinh is a powerful name that signifies the divine union of strength and beauty. It is believed to bring courage, victory, and prosperity to the bearer.
data.etymology: Mayursinh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Mountain, Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mayursinh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mayursinh" carries rich symbolism in Hindu culture. It suggests the union of two powerful and iconic creatures, evoking strength, beauty, and royalty. Peacocks and lions were often depicted together in Hindu art and literature, symbolizing the eternal battle between good (peacock, represented by Vishnu) and evil (lion, represented by Shiva). Their union is a reminder of the cycle of life and death, purity and power, and harmony between the natural world and the divine.
data.spiritual_significance: Mayursinh is an evocative name rooted in Hindu spirituality and mythology. It represents the divine energies of the Sun God, Agni, and Vishnu combined. Mayursinh is believed to be a embodiment of strength, courage, and power. The word 'Mayur' also represents the sun, which is a source of light and life, while 'Sinh' represents courage and eliminator of fears. Being a manipurush (auspicious) name, Mayursinh is believed to bring blessings of good health, abundance, and long life, with the power to dispel negativity and obstacles. Ultimately, this name is a reminder of one's inner strength and the power of the divine that resides within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mayursinh: Mayur (Peacock) represents beauty and grace, while Sinh (Lion) symbolizes power and courage. Thus, Mayursinh embodies the harmonious blend of inner strength, courage, and radiant beauty.
